rules: All three require exact nodeid, exact reason, call-phase skip, complete normal setup/call/teardown, hash-verified unchanged source and the named observed runtime predicate.
pandas absence: both distribution metadata and module spec absent at collection. Broken or installed-but-unimportable pandas is NOT accepted; no dependency is added.

Current catalog: the NORMAL TEST's actual skip traceback has original_db=TestDB and rows=[] from its own sys.databases query; no extra SQL probe or test rewrite. An unexpected database error or unsupported-catalog skip is NOT accepted.
Integer conversion: the NORMAL TEST's skip frame has limit=0 AND runtime API reports zero/unavailable. Modern patched runtimes normally execute it; no limit is changed.

Runtime dependencies and DB/source skips are rejected even if marked statically. Other unchanged active static platform/optional-profiler/pandas marks are frozen per node at collection and must match exact reason at execution.
No module-level skip is approved: required core/pyarrow/ODBC must import, and all source files exist in a complete protected checkout.

The other78 dynamic sites are INVENTORY ONLY, not approved exceptions. Driver capability/timeouts/collations/encoding and permission skips without a reviewed exact predicate remain first-attempt nonaccepted evidence; never rerun or auto-allow.
